openItems.explanation: 26-01261 (AJ-26-0633) debits account 1300 and credits Pier 9 contract revenue $48,000.00, dated June 30, 2026 and posted August 8, 2026 at 9:41 PM, after June was closed, by the Controller, with no approval and no support; it reversed on July 2, 2026. Proposed: reverse it in FY2026 (revenue and account 1300 down $48,000.00) and remove the July 2 reversal from FY2027. The trial balance the other FY2026 areas read does not include it.

The CPA evaluates whether TOP-01 is an override of controls: an unsupported revenue entry by the person who closes the books, posted after the close and two days before the compliance certificate went to the bank, set to reverse. The CPA decides what to ask the officers and whether the risk assessment or other procedures change.
The policy says a closed period is locked; the system’s period lock is not used, and FY2026 accepted an entry five days after the year was closed. A control deficiency for the CPA to evaluate.

26-01259 (AJ-26-0631), the $26,900.00 depreciation true-up, was prepared, posted and approved by the Controller. The amount recomputes from the register; the approval is not independent. A control deficiency, with JE-01.

40 manual entries over $25,000, $9,763,571.44, were posted by the Controller with no one else’s approval: the control walkthroughs’ 30 ($8,045,083.44), the 8 top-side entries after them and the 2 keyed outside the journal screen. The walkthroughs proposed it as a significant deficiency; the CPA decides with SOD-01 whether it is a material weakness.

The manual journal listing covers the journal screen only. 2 manual entries keyed on the bank and equipment screens, $282,600.00, are not on it, so the walkthroughs’ test of manual entries could not see them. Recommendation: report manual entries from every screen.
26-00803 credits the crane sale proceeds to accumulated depreciation, the equipment audit’s SALE-01. Not proposed again here.
Materiality is proposed at $340,000.00, 0.5% of revenue, with performance materiality $255,000.00. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.
No management representation letter has been obtained. It should cover the completeness of the ledger, the entries after the close and the absence of other unrecorded entries.
These are draft workpapers and a draft findings memo for the engagement partner. They are not an audit report and give no opinion. Nothing has been signed, posted or sent.
